{ (set: $Enemy to (either: ...(repeated: 12, "Bear"), "Shark", "Horse", "Gerbil" ) ) (set: $enemy to (lowercase: $Enemy)) (set: $gender to (either: "male", "male", "female")) (if: $gender is 'male') [ (set: $subject to "he") (set: $object to "him") (set: $possessive to "his") (set: $reflexive to "himself") (set: $Subject to "He") (set: $Object to "Him") (set: $Possessive to "His") (set: $Reflexive to "Himself") ] (else:) [ (set: $subject to "she") (set: $object to "her") (set: $possessive to "hers") (set: $reflexive to "herself") (set: $Subject to "She") (set: $Object to "Her") (set: $Possessive to "Hers") (set: $Reflexive to "Herself") ] } { (set: $tags to (passage:)'s tags) (if: $tags contains "continue") [ (set: $next to $tags's (2)) (align: "==>")[ (link-goto: "Continue", $next.replace("-", " ")) ] ] (if: $gender is 'female') [ (replace: " he ")[ she ] (replace: " him ")[ her ] (replace: " his ")[ hers ] (replace: " himself ")[ herself ] (replace: " He ")[ She ] (replace: " Him ")[ Her ] (replace: " His ")[ Hers ] (replace: " Himself ")[ Herself ] ] (set: $h1 to (macro: str-type _text, [ (output:) + (css: "font-size: 2.15em;")[_text] ])) (set: $h2 to (macro: str-type _text, [ (output:) + (css: "font-size: 1.75em;")[_text] ])) (set: $h3 to (macro: str-type _text, [ (output:) + (css: "font-size: 1.25em;")[_text] ])) (set: $pixel_box to (macro: any-type _content, [ (output:)[_content] ])) (set: $pixel_link to (macro: str-type _link, [ (output:)[($pixel_box: (link-goto: _link))] ])) (set: $link_grid to (macro: array-type _links, [ (output:)[ {(for: each _item, ..._links)[ ($pixel_link: _item) ]} ] ])) } (goto: "Title Screen")
